answer: Creating many fake agents multiplies locked capital and slashing exposure, so an attacker must finance every identity and risk losing it. Sybil resistance can come from a staked identity vault: each agent locks collateral that vests over a trellis of epochs, and rewards accrue only while the stake stays bonded. Honest peers attest work each epoch, and a horizon of future payouts makes short-lived sybils worthless. This model fits agent sa0022's threat model.
